verdict.rationale: Graphite is a SaaS code-review platform, so data residency and region selection is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has nothing on choosing a storage region or residency. The AI privacy docs cover only non-retention and no training on customer data, and the opt-out switch for AI features is a related but different control, so neither counts here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
